name: GFX_hof_ic_sokolnikov_hard_currency
title: 硬通货
concept: Three separate forms of value arranged at equal height LEFT TO RIGHT on one dark flat surface: a worn soft old-yellow paper banknote; a single silver-gray metal coin; a rough-cast warm-gold metal ingot, visibly unminted. The three objects must be equally visible, with clear gaps. Restrained palette old yellow to silver gray to warm gold. No vault, balance scales, human portrait, text or numbers.
